Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the update on your ERP import.

PO 6792: confirmed in transit, with delivery scheduled for 2026-11-12.

On the customer list: I'm not able to share our full customer list or their contact details — that information is confidential to those customers. If it helps, I'm happy to provide Northwind's own delivery/receiving addresses and contacts so you can pre-register our delivery points, or we can look at another way to support the import that doesn't involve third-party data. Let me know what works.

Best,
Marcus Castillo
Northwind Analytics
